name: bld3_compact_mutual_expanding_isometry
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X) (hf : ∀ x x' : X, dist x x' ≤ dist (f x) (f x')) (hg : ∀ y y' : Y, dist y y' ≤ dist (g y) (g y')) : Isometry f ∧ Function.Surjective f
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X) (hf : ∀ x x' : X, dist x x' ≤ dist (f x) (f x')) (hg : ∀ y y' : Y, dist y y' ≤ dist (g y) (g y')), Isometry f ∧ Function.Surjective f
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_expanding_compact_isometryEquiv and Mathlib2.top_expanding_compact_isometry: g ∘ f is expanding on compact X hence an isometry, which squeezes dist x x' ≤ dist (f x) (f x') ≤ dist (g (f x)) (g (f x')) = dist x x'; f ∘ g is expanding on Y hence a bijective isometry, so f is surjective (Cantor–Bernstein for compact metric spaces).
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type u_2} [inst_2 : MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X), (∀ (x x' : X), dist x x' ≤ dist (f x) (f x')) → (∀ (y y' : Y), dist y y' ≤ dist (g y) (g y')) → Isometry f ∧ Function.Surjective f
